# Owned UU and XXE inputs

All payloads and harness files are project-owned and redistributable under the repository license. `ordinary` contains `Owned UU/XXE payload.\n` repeated 17 times followed by byte values 0–255; `tails` contains byte values 0–45; `empty` is empty. Traditional members are generated through the public stream encoder of [UUDeview](https://github.com/hannob/uudeview) at commit `7640bc56aa5016cdc9c139eb1ab3ec874e47c744`. The reference is GPL-2.0-or-later and remains a separate local test tool; none of its source or binaries are copied into these inputs or the product. The owned harness invokes only the stream encoder; unreachable POSIX temporary-file decoder calls abort on Windows.

`spaces.uu` applies the documented UU zero alias and CRLF to independently generated UU bytes. `base64.uue` uses Python's standard Base64 encoder/decoder and the documented `begin-base64` envelope. `multi.uue` combines independent UU/XX members with equal names, a Base64 member and owned transport text. Original header modes grant no product authority.

Clone the pinned reference under `build/toolchain/references/uudeview-7640bc5`, then run `python scripts/generate-uu-fixtures.py --reference build/toolchain/references/uudeview-7640bc5`. The generator verifies the commit and unmodified reference sources, builds the owned public-API harness using the current C toolchain, and independently decodes UU with Python `binascii`. Add `--check` to compare checked-in inputs without changing them. On Windows use an initialized MSVC x64 developer environment. Compiler output and the reference manifest stay under `build/review/format-expansion/`.
